fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced property (black ornamental metal perimeter fence confirmed in 2016 & 2026 Street View). Single controlled truck entrance off the Greenbrier Pkwy loop road at the SE; Target monument/bullseye sign at the entrance throat (2026-04 SV). Drive is set back well beyond public-road SV coverage so the gate arm itself is not directly imaged, but the secured single-throat layout is unambiguous.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true. Could not positively image a small dedicated booth at the road pinch (SV does not reach the private drive), but a yard-operations building with an adjacent truck-scale pad sits at the SE throat (34.6446,-86.8446); modern Target RDCs of this class are built with an exterior guard house (corroborated by Walsh Group's Target DC build spec). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: A long rectangular gridded concrete pad adjacent to the SE yard-operations building (34.6446,-86.8446) reads as a truck scale / weigh pad. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large NW drop yard packed with 100+ marked trailer stalls, many green Target trailers, no tractors — 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock banks on the building's north face (facing the drop yard) and east face (trailers backed in along the east wall), well over 50 doors total.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on different building faces (north face into drop yard, east face apron) suggest separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved aprons inside the fence between the gate and the dock banks provide ample interior queuing.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane entrance apron at the loop-road throat with unused paved width.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial on the Madison/Huntsville fringe, bordered by active farm fields to the west and a tree line to the south — Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Door/trailer counts are honest overhead estimates from zoom-19/20 imagery, not exact. buildingCount=3 (main DC, SE yard-ops/transportation office, SW pump house).
